title_zh: 商定通过用户试用选择展示原型

scenario.label_zh: 在产品分歧中商定比较原型的方法
scenario.goal_zh: 说明两款原型的取舍，并约定不由个人偏好单独决定而先观察试用

context_zh: 两位产品合作创始人选择下月演示所用的原型。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Nell
sentences.text: We have a dilemma: the simple prototype is easy to learn, but the other one shows more of what we can build.

sentences.speaker: Oscar
sentences.text: I prefer the second, though I do not want to dictate the choice just because I designed it.

sentences.speaker: Nell
sentences.text: I appreciate that. My ego is involved too; I have defended the simple one all week.

sentences.speaker: Oscar
sentences.text: Could we watch a few first-time users try both before we decide?

sentences.speaker: Nell
sentences.text: Yes. Give them the same task and do not explain the controls unless they ask.

sentences.speaker: Oscar
sentences.text: Then we can compare where they get stuck rather than which design we like more.

sentences.speaker: Nell
sentences.text: Agreed. I will arrange the sessions, and we will choose the demo version after reviewing them together.
